agents.name: GreetingAgent
agents.description: Validates user ID and greets user by name with city and conditions

agents.name: MoodTrackerAgent
agents.description: Captures user mood, stores with numeric score, computes rolling average

agents.name: CGMAgent
agents.description: Logs glucose readings (valid range 80-300 mg/dL), flags alerts, returns history
agents.trigger: LLM classifier detects glucose/sugar mention or number

agents.name: FoodIntakeAgent
agents.description: Records meals with timestamps, estimates macronutrients via LLM, flags high-carb for diabetics
agents.trigger: Food log form submission on dashboard

agents.name: MealPlannerAgent
agents.description: Generates adaptive 3-meal daily plan based on conditions, CGM, mood, and dietary preference with clinical rationale
agents.trigger: Generate Meal Plan button on dashboard

agents.name: InterruptAgent
agents.description: Handles general health queries at any point using user's stored medical profile. Routes user back to previous flow after answering.
agents.trigger: LLM classifier detects general question or advice request
